polityNote: Great Socialist People's Libyan Arab Jamahiriya until 2011, then the State of Libya. NE's 22 features are the 22 shabiyat of GPC Secretariat Resolution 43/2006 as amended in 2006, several carrying stale 2001-era names (NE «Al Qubbah» = Derna, «Ajdabiya» = Al Wahat, «Ghadamis» = Nalut, «Mizdah» = Jabal al Gharbi, «Tajura'…» = Tripoli; NE's own gn_name fields confirm).
